text:
Subject: A gentle reminder about our meeting times

Hi there,

I hope you are having a lovely day. I wanted to share a quick thought with you regarding our client meetings. Punctuality is a key part of how we present our professionalism to our clients, and we want to ensure we are always making the best possible impression.

I have noticed that you have been arriving a bit late to a few recent sessions. While I know life can be busy and unpredictable, consistent timeliness is important for our team's reputation. Please try to make every effort to arrive on time for our future engagements.

On a lighter note, as you head out to your next appointment, take a moment to look up at the sky. It is fascinating to think that the rain we sometimes experience comes from fluffy things in the sky. Let that be a reminder that even when things seem heavy or urgent, there is beauty and lightness to be found if we look for it.

Thank you for your attention to this matter and for your continued hard work.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
